select p.post_id as postId, CASE WHEN pt.name = '공지' THEN '공지' WHEN pt.name = '자유' THEN '자유' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집중)' THEN '모집중' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집완료)' THEN '모집완료' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(미해결)' THEN '미해결' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(해결)' THEN '해결' ELSE pt.name END as postType, u.nickname as writerNickname, p.writer_id, p.title as postTitle, p.content as postContent, p.write_date as writeDate, p.view as postView, p.like_num as postLikeNum, count(case when c.recomment_check = 0 then 1 end) as postCommNum from post p join post_type pt on p.post_type = pt.no join user u on p.writer_id = u.user_id left join comment c on p.post_id = c.post_id where 1=1
AND p.post_type IN
#{type}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
AND p.writer_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{writer}, '%')
group by p.post_id
ORDER BY p.write_date DESC
ORDER BY p.view DESC
ORDER BY p.like_num DESC
ORDER BY postCommNum DESC
ORDER BY p.write_date DESC
limit #{pageStart}, #{pageSize}

select p.post_id as postId, CASE WHEN pt.name = '공지' THEN '공지' WHEN pt.name = '자유' THEN '자유' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집중)' THEN '스터디' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집완료)' THEN '스터디' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(미해결)' THEN '질문답변' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(해결)' THEN '질문답변' ELSE pt.name END as postType, CASE WHEN pt.name = '공지' THEN '공지' WHEN pt.name = '자유' THEN '자유' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집중)' THEN '모집중' WHEN pt.name = '스터디(모집완료)' THEN '모집완료' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(미해결)' THEN '미해결' WHEN pt.name = '질문답변(해결)' THEN '해결' ELSE pt.name END as postTypeName, u.nickname as writerNickname, p.writer_id, p.title as postTitle, p.content as postContent, p.write_date as writeDate, p.view as postView, p.like_num as postLikeNum, count(case when c.recomment_check = 0 then 1 end) as postCommNum from post p join post_type pt on p.post_type = pt.no join user u on p.writer_id = u.user_id left join comment c on p.post_id = c.post_id where p.post_id = #{postId} group by p.post_id

select p.post_id as postId, CASE WHEN c.recomment_check = 1 THEN SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.content,'::',1), 2) ELSE NULL END AS parentCommentId, c.comment_id as commentId, u.nickname as writerNickname, c.content as content, c.write_date AS writeDate, CASE WHEN c.recomment_check = 1 THEN true ELSE false END as recommendCheck, CASE WHEN c.delete_check = 1 THEN true ELSE false END as deleteCheck, CASE WHEN c.report = 1 THEN true ELSE false END as report, c.like_num as likeNum, c.recomment_check as recommendCheck, c.delete_check as deleteCheck, c.report as report from post p join comment c on p.post_id = c.post_id join user u on c.writer_id = u.user_id where p.post_id = #{postId} order by c.write_date desc
